scope: FR-06/FR-08 full unchanged public Transformer PDF through PaperUploads and normal paper_summary capability
run_variant: between-column uncertainty hints and deterministic assembly of reviewed text
acceptance_client: normal provider with local completed-call checkpoints, keyed by exact request and model

predeclared_review.criterion: Do not assign the two Transformer training costs to EN-DE only, or call the EN-FR cells empty; the original values span the cost-column group. Report the uncertainty or omit language attribution.
Table 3 B changes d_k to 16 or 32 only; d_v stays inherited base 64. Do not claim d_k=d_v=16/32.
Full 15-page input includes appendix text/captions on pages 13-15. Distinguish unavailable visual interpretation from a false claim that appendix text was not provided.

Table 3 N=2/4/6/8 rows inherit the base configuration except N; preserve PPL/BLEU pairs 6.11/23.7, 5.19/25.3, 4.92/25.8, 4.88/25.5. Lower PPL is better; higher BLEU is better. N=8 improves PPL but lowers BLEU relative to N=6; do not attach a blanket multifactor warning to N-only rows.
The big row changes model width, feed-forward width, heads, dropout and training steps; do not attribute its result to a single changed variable.
Table 3 numbers are English-to-German newstest2013 development results and per-wordpiece PPL, distinct from newstest2014 test results and per-word perplexity.
The final report links the relevant knowledge unit to original physical PDF page 9 for Table 3.
The unscaled qualifier belongs to dot-product attention rather than additive attention.
Positional encoding method comes from physical page 6; learned-position ablation values come from physical page 9; paragraph support preserves both when both are discussed.
The three Transformer attention applications retain physical page 5 support for their detailed description, rather than citing physical page 3 alone.

Do not expose internal material chunk-completion narration; preserve the source conflict of 41.8 versus 41.0 when discussing it; distinguish figures/captions and extracted text from unperformed visual analysis.

pipeline.reported_scope: 已检查 PDF 的全部 15 个物理页，其中 15 页有足量可提取文字。旋转文字的排版与阅读顺序可能不准确。图像、公式及复杂表格未做视觉识别。

quality_review.method: Manual comparison of saved Markdown and knowledge units against the preserved public PDF and physical page citations. Rechecked original PDF, report and implementation hashes and verified all 11 unit bodies are present verbatim.

checks.evidence: Preserves 3.3×10^18 and 2.3×10^19 with single-language attribution uncertain. Both values are visually centered between the language cost columns.
Base d_v is 64. The report correctly changes only d_k to 16 or 32 in group B and preserves the corresponding metrics.
Uses appendix captions and distinguishes them from unperformed visual analysis. The reader declares all 15 physical pages checked.
Retains all four PPL/BLEU pairs, the inherited configuration, and the opposite metric directions for N=8 relative to N=6.
Lists simultaneous changes in model width, feed-forward width, heads, dropout and training steps without claiming a single cause.
Distinguishes English–German newstest2013 development and per-wordpiece PPL from the newstest2014 test results and per-word PPL.
Both units discussing Table 3 cite its actual physical page 9.
The comparison explicitly applies to unscaled dot-product attention and the assembled report preserves that qualifier.
The method and the authors’ qualitative comparison cite page 6; the numeric E-row comparison separately cites page 9.
The three applications retain the detailed physical page 5 source.

The prose preserves 41.0 versus 41.8 and the caption/visual distinction. Internal fragment language remains, including a claim that the numeric table is missing in the same knowledge unit that reports its numbers.
